title: 9:5 boot of a soldier . . . shall be for burning. Boots, garments, weapons, chariots, and other items used during a holy war were not to become part of the booty or spoil of the victors. Such property was under a ban and had to be burned with fire (Josh. 7:23-26; 11:6, 9; Ps. 46:9; Ezek. 39:9-10).
author: Tina M. Peterson
